name: 78756 · Austin, TX
findings: ZIP 78756 (Austin) has 77 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78756 (Austin) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 78756 (Austin) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 39 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
